convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ForecastOscilator indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trading logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose), which contains money management and position management functions not available as built-in MT5 indicators.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: BUY_Close triggered when ForecastOscilator buffer 2 (DnValue) has non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on a historical bar scan (bars from SignalBar+1 onward)
SELL_Close triggered when ForecastOscilator buffer 3 (UpValue) has non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on a historical bar scan

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses. MM input (0.1) is the multiplier/fraction depending on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: Signal is read from bar index SignalBar (default=1, previous bar). When SignalBar=0, signals can fire on every tick without new bar check. Historical bar scan loop (from SignalBar+1 to Bars_) searches for opposite signals to set close flags, but only if both open and close are enabled for same side AND no close signal already exists. The close signals from the historical scan take priority over the signal_reversal_close from the current signal bar. UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime are calculated as last bar date + TimeShiftSec, passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen for trade timing. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of ForecastOscilator custom indicator (T3-based forecasting oscillator with 4 buffers). TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) must be reimplemented - particularly the 5 margin mode position sizing logic. The SignalBar=1 pattern means reading the previous completed bar for signals, which maps to pandas iloc[-2] in Python. Historical bar scan for exit signals is an unusual pattern that must be carefully replicated. SL/TP are in points (1000/2000), which at 5-digit brokers equals 100/200 pips - digit adjustment depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh implementation which is not visible.
